    Get Started

    Introduction

    Welcome to the API documentation of Chargily Pay™. The easiest way to integrate e-payment API through EDAHABIA of Algerie Poste and CIB of SATIM into your App, Website or any project.

    Chargily Pay, a gateway that allows you to accept online payments with many payment methods in Algeria such as EDAHABIA and CIB cards. You are in the right place if you want to know how to integrate Chargily Pay into your website or application.

    Start The Integration

    A tutorial that guides you through a basic interaction with the Chargily Pay API.

    API Reference

    Checkout the API reference for a complete list of available endpoints.
